text:
alex: pushed fixes for PR #1247 — handled the config edge case and addressed the flaky test you flagged. PTAL when you get a sec. I won't be able to merge later today (oncall), so would appreciate someone taking merge ownership if CI is green.
maria: looking now, starting with the unit tests...
maria: quick skim — looks good overall, left one tiny docs nit inline.
chen: I can pick this up and take merge custody if CI stays green. Do you have backout steps?
alex: thanks @chen. Backout notes added to the PR description (short commands). Rollback snippet: `./deploy rollback --pr 1247 --to-rev v2026.03.16`. I also re-ran the flaky test locally and pushed the fix.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline for PR #1247 — integration: passed, e2e: queued (position 3).
maria: resolved that docs nit and pushed. Ran linter & unit tests locally, all passing :thumbsup:.
chen: great. I'll wait for e2e, then promote to canary and watch the metrics. tagging @ops-bot for monitoring.
ops-bot: acknowledged — will monitor canary metrics and alert if error rate or latency deviates >5% from baseline.
alex: perfect, thanks everyone. If canary looks healthy please merge during the next merge window (~60m). If anything blocks, @chen please drop a note here and I'll jump in.
chen: noted — will merge if canary is stable, otherwise we'll revert asap and post an incident channel update.
